system.description:
Deal [[/r 7d6 + @battle-status.power.attack.total]]{[(SR+6)D + (Attack Power)]}  physical damage to the target.

(Extra): After the end of the current Main Process, if the target's HP is equal to or less than your [Attack Power] or the target has [Mob], the target dies.

A special skill that swings the weapon held with both hands with the whole body and unleashes a powerful blow. The destructive power worthy of the name of execution is enough to instantly kill a lower-ranked enemy.
